roomId.description: The room whose group admits a member. The recipient MUST hold its group.

host.description: The room's host, as a DID: where the room's epoch advances. Named by the caller because the recipient holds key custody, not a hosting register.

member.description: The DID being admitted. The KeyPackage's leaf credential MUST identify it; one that names anyone else is refused, so an owner never admits a party other than the one they meant.

keyPackage.description: The newcomer's MLS KeyPackage, base64url without padding, as rooms/keys/key-package returned it.

reason.description: Why, carried to the host's epoch advance. Untrusted and attributed to its author: it MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential.

Response.title: Rooms Owner Group Add — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/owner/group/add. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/owner/group/add/0.1#response. The room's new epoch, and the Welcome for the caller to deliver to the newcomer's key holder with rooms/keys/welcome.

epoch.description: The room epoch after the admission, as the host recorded it.

welcome.description: The MLS Welcome, base64url, sealed to the newcomer's KeyPackage. For rooms/keys/welcome; never through the host.

ratchetTree.description: The group's ratchet tree, base64url, where the Welcome does not carry it as an extension. Passed to rooms/keys/welcome unchanged.
